timing: Fixed before switch candidate outputs; never used for model weights or checkpoint selection.
scope: Finite120 authored profile/spec/explicit-topic-switch/reference/boundary/definition/reasoning questions, not representative general dialogue or independent human assessment.

dimensions.relevance: 2: answers the requested topic, field and condition; 1: related but incomplete; 0: wrong topic or field.
dimensions.facts: 2: agrees with the approved source or provided arithmetic and does not invent information; 1: omits a requested fact; 0: incorrect or unsupported assertion.
dimensions.japanese: 2: complete coherent Japanese; 1: comprehensible but awkward; 0: unfinished, broken grammar or nonsensical repetition.
dimensions.style: 2: direct owner voice, concise requested detail, no redundant favorites preface or mechanical suffix; 1: unnecessary repetition or preface; 0: prohibited third-person reporting or unusable presentation.

passingRule: All four dimensions must be 2. Correct grammar alone cannot compensate for wrong facts, wrong battery conditions or irrelevant responses.
procedure: Exact gold matches receive 2 in all dimensions after the authored gold has been reviewed. Every other answer is inspected individually; any semantic equivalents are recorded without altering the frozen gold or exact-match report. EOS, UTF-8 validity and context exhaustion are reported separately.
arithmeticCaveat: Four0-20 addition pairs hold out both orders from QA training/validation. Arithmetic sampling is de-emphasized for stages1-3; retained diagnostic must still be reported, not excluded from the score.
